data.narrative:
Dispatcher is an early-stage company in the Defense & Security sector, founded by Nick Clouse and Maxwell Wang. The comparable universe for this analysis comprises 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers, including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, Shield AI, and Saronic. These 10 firms represent the broader Defense & Security investment landscape, though none provide direct stage-aligned benchmarks.

Peer-median valuation methods prove inapplicable here. Of 26 same-sector peers identified, filtering for stage alignment, adjacent-stage proximity, or similar valuation tier yielded fewer than three datapoints in any category—the minimum threshold for meaningful triangulation. Relying on all-sector medians would introduce material distortion given the heterogeneity of Defense & Security valuations across stages and business models. Consequently, traditional comparable-company analysis cannot be reliably executed.

Given the absence of sufficiently dense peer clustering and undisclosed current valuation and fundraising history, quantitative triangulation is not supported by the available data. Any valuation conclusion would require either (1) expansion of the comparable set through additional stage-matched private transactions, (2) disclosure of Dispatcher's specific revenue, growth rate, or margin profile relative to named peers, or (3) application of alternative methods (DCF, sum-of-the-parts) using target-specific financials not present in this dataset. The analysis cannot responsibly narrow a valuation range without these inputs.
